nodes.label: Train-lock design system
nodes.rationale: Single look-fasit for all AK Golf HQ surfaces (PlayerHQ, Workbench, AgencyOS, AgenticOS, Jarvis, Foreldreportal) so screens built in different sessions stay visually identical; HANDOFF.md wins on structure, DESIGN-SYSTEM.md wins on visual values.

nodes.label: Train-lock color tokens (mørk default / lys)
nodes.rationale: Scene #000000 dark / #FFFFFF light with inverted-but-identical geometry token set (elev, dock, hair, dim, text, mute, fill/on-fill, target, ok, warn, danger, warm, shot, avatar) so every screen swaps palette without redesign; ok-green reserved for Player 'Godta' only to avoid diluting its meaning elsewhere.

nodes.label: Button color matrix (§6)
nodes.rationale: Codifies which button gets which color per context (Godta=ok-green only in Workbench Player WB-04, Godkjenn/Godkjenn start in AgenticOS is always white/never green, Publiser is white in Agency uke) so no screen accidentally implies success/approval with the wrong color.

nodes.label: Motion system (transform/opacity only, easing tokens)
nodes.rationale: Frequency-based 'skal-det-animeres' gate (100+/day = none, sjelden/first-time = delight allowed) keeps daily screens (I dag, bookinger) free of entrance animation while modals/sheets get standard motion; reduced-motion and reduced-transparency media queries are mandatory.

nodes.label: Component reuse table (§5)
nodes.rationale: Named component anatomies (Nå-kort, Agenda-rad, Liste-rad, Bento, Pyramide-snapshot, Prikk-måned, Toggle, ØR-avatar, Uke-rutenett, Publish-confirm, DispersionMap, Godkjenn-kort, Rail/tabbar, Telefonramme) each point to one canonical fasit-fil so new screens copy the pattern instead of inventing a new one.

nodes.label: Privacy rules (§8)
nodes.rationale: Forelder ser kun eget barns fornavn og aggregerte tall, aldri medisinsk/skadedetalj; DRAFT usynlig for spiller; agent skriver aldri PUBLISHED eller gruppe-master direkte; 'Ikke delta' skjuler (hiddenByPlayer) men sletter aldri — encodes the app's core consent/PII invariants directly into the design fasit.
